Class AbstractMemoryExecutor

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.memory.executor.AbstractMemoryExecutor
All Implemented Interfaces:
tech.kayys.gamelan.engine.plugin.GamelanPlugin, tech.kayys.gamelan.plugin.executor.ExecutorPlugin
Direct Known Subclasses:
UnifiedMemoryExecutor
public abstract class AbstractMemoryExecutor extends Object implements tech.kayys.gamelan.plugin.executor.ExecutorPlugin
Abstract base class for all memory executors. Provides common functionality for memory operations including store, retrieve, search, update, and delete.
